title: 1inch CHI
tagline: Next generation gas token with a helper for deploying contracts for almost the half of the gas costs.
description: The idea of the Chi token is based on the original gas token GST2 implementation. We wrote more efficient next generation gas token and an additional smart contract with a functionality to deploy smart contracts and burning Chi tokens to reduce the deployment costs.
how_its_made: We built it with Solidity on Ethereum by debugging assembly code. Integration in 1inch for the Chi minter for easy onboarding and trading opportunity. Mined 12 zeros address for Chi token in the AWS cloud.
